---
title: "Publications"
bibliography: Flournoy.bib
csl: apa-cv.csl
format:
  html:
    # Quarto builds its TOC from the AST *before* filters run, so the year
    # headings that group-years.lua injects can never appear in it. Leaving
    # the TOC on would render an empty sidebar.
    toc: false
    # Shows and hides entries by project; the bar and tags come from
    # project-tags.lua.
    include-after-body: project-filter.html
nocite: |
  @*
# Run citeproc ourselves (via citeproc.lua) so the two filters below operate on
# the *rendered* bibliography. Quarto's built-in citeproc would otherwise run
# last, after these filters had nothing to act on.
citeproc: false
filters:
  - citeproc.lua
  - bold-it.lua
  # Before group-years.lua so it sees citeproc's own output shape.
  - oa-links.lua
  # After oa-links.lua so the tags sit below the [PDF] link; before
  # group-years.lua so it walks the flat list and emits one filter bar.
  - project-tags.lua
  - group-years.lua
---

Peer-reviewed articles, preprints, and my dissertation, newest first. My name
is **bolded** throughout. Where a free copy exists, it is linked at the end of
the reference. The tags under a paper name the larger study it came out of;
click one to see only that study's papers.
